name: Scarred Bulette

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

weaknesses.name: Charm
weaknesses.details: (a tortured bulette hit by a charm attack is immobilized until the end of its next turn)

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Habituated to Torture
traits.details: While the scarred bulette is bloodied, it gains a +2 bonus to all defenses and to speed.

powers.name: Bite
powers.range: Before it bites, the bulette can make a standing long jump (as a free action) without provoking opportunity attacks

attacks.name: Hit

hit.description: damage, or 4d8+6 damage against a prone target

powers.name: Earth Furrow
powers.range: The scarred bulette moves its burrow speed just below the surface of the ground, avoiding opportunity attacks as it passes underneath other creatures’ spaces. As it burrows beneath the space of a Medium or smaller creature on the ground, the bulette makes an attack against the creature

powers.name: Rising Burst
powers.requirements: the bulette must have emerged from the ground after burrowing this turn
powers.flavorText: the bulette sprays rocks and dirt into the air when it rises out of the ground

powers.name: Spray of Tainted Blood
powers.trigger: when an adjacent creature hits the scarred bulette with a melee attack

effect.description: The attacker takes a -2 penalty to Fortitude until the end of the scarred bulette’s next turn.
